subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The amount of sleep you require changes greatly throughout your life, _______ on your age, activity level, overall health, and lifestyle patterns.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3) **i.e. **'depending'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Depending (निर्भर करना)** - Relying on something or someone for something.

 
 
• **Example: **We shall proceed **depending **on the completion of this project.
 
 
 
• In this context, the given sentence implies that the amount of sleep changes depending on age, activity level etc.
 
• Hence, **'depending' **is the correct word to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the complete sentence is "The amount of sleep you require changes greatly throughout your life, **depending**__ on your age, activity level, overall health, and lifestyle patterns." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Correlating (सहसंबंधित करना)** - To find or show a connection between two or more things.

 
 
• **Example:** They are correlating the survey results with local census data.
 
 
 
• **Suspecting (शंका करना)** - Thinking someone to be guilty of something without having concrete evidence.
 
 
• **Example: **Police were suspecting him for his suspicious activities around the crime scene.
 
 
 
• **Distrusting (अविश्वास करना)** - Doubting the honesty or reliability of a person or thing.
 
 
• **Example: **Despite her sweet words, he was distrusting her intentions.
